scenes.title: Checkout is still spinning
scenes.label: ASHA'S CHECKOUT
scenes.voice: Asha taps Place Order during a sale. Checkout keeps spinning, then times out. Her payment may already have succeeded.
scenes.note: A timeout is not proof of failure.

cues.text: Asha taps Place Order during a sale.

scenes.title: Cheap waiting is not extra capacity
scenes.label: WHAT VIRTUAL THREADS CHANGE
scenes.voice: Java twenty one virtual threads make blocking waits cheaper. They do not make the payment provider faster.
scenes.note: Efficient waiting does not add database connections.

cues.text: Java twenty one virtual threads make blocking waits
cheaper.
They do not make the payment provider faster.

scenes.title: The queue moves downstream
scenes.label: THE REAL BOTTLENECK
scenes.voice: Five hundred waiting requests cannot use a database pool with twenty connections at once. The queue simply moves downstream.

cues.text: Five hundred waiting requests cannot use a database
pool with twenty connections at once.
The queue simply moves downstream.

scenes.title: One durable payment identity
scenes.label: MAKE RETRIES PAYMENT-SAFE
scenes.voice: First, save one durable payment attempt. Repeated clicks reuse the same reference. Never create another charge just because checkout timed out.
scenes.note: Reject the same key with a different request payload.

cues.text: First, save one durable payment attempt.
Repeated clicks reuse the same reference.
Never create another charge just because checkout timed
out.

scenes.title: Bound calls and waiting work
scenes.label: BULKHEAD + BACKPRESSURE
scenes.voice: Then bound active calls and waiting work. A bulkhead protects the provider. Work not started gets an honest busy response.
scenes.note: A local semaphore is not a global provider quota.

cues.text: Then bound active calls and waiting work.
A bulkhead protects the provider.
Work not started gets an honest busy response.

scenes.title: UNKNOWN needs reconciliation
scenes.label: REAL DEADLINES · HONEST STATUS
scenes.voice: Set real network deadlines. If payment is uncertain, keep the original reference and reconcile. A timeout is not proof of cancellation.
scenes.note: Do not blindly authorize or capture a second payment.

cues.text: Set real network deadlines.
If payment is uncertain, keep the original reference
and reconcile.
A timeout is not proof of cancellation.

scenes.title: A reliable checkout outcome
scenes.label: CUSTOMER PROTECTED
scenes.voice: Now checkout reports a reliable status. Virtual threads improve waiting efficiency. Capacity limits, backpressure and payment safe recovery protect the customer.
scenes.note: Short transactions · bounded capacity · safe recovery
